study_type: observational cohort study using machine learning
key_claims: A machine-learning model estimated brain age from EEG recordings during sleep.
An older-than-expected brain age was associated with a higher risk of developing dementia.
For every 10-year increase between estimated brain age and actual age, the likelihood of developing dementia rose by nearly 40%.
People whose estimated brain age was younger than their actual age had a lower risk.
The association remained significant after adjusting for education, smoking, body mass index, physical activity, other medical conditions, and genetic risk factors.
The model combined 13 microscopic features from EEG brain wave recordings.
limitations: The study was observational, so causality cannot be established.
The study population may not be representative of all groups.
The model's accuracy in real-world settings is not yet validated.
The source does not specify the exact sensitivity or specificity of the model.
what_not_to_say: The model can predict dementia with certainty.
Sleep-based brain age measurement is ready for clinical use.
Improving sleep health will definitely reduce dementia risk.
The study proves that brain aging causes dementia.

key_claims: The Mediterranean diet may influence aging through tiny proteins produced inside the cell's mitochondria.
Older adults who followed the diet most closely had higher levels of humanin and SHMOOSE.
Humanin and SHMOOSE have been linked to heart and brain protection.
Olive oil, fish, legumes, and fewer refined carbohydrates appeared especially important.
The findings could eventually help scientists develop more personalized nutrition plans for healthy aging.
limitations: The source does not specify the study design or sample size.
The source does not provide effect sizes or statistical significance.
The source does not mention potential confounding factors.
The source does not indicate whether the findings are causal.
what_not_to_say: The Mediterranean diet causes higher levels of humanin and SHMOOSE.
Humanin and SHMOOSE definitively protect the heart and brain.
The Mediterranean diet is proven to slow aging.
Specific foods like olive oil and fish are solely responsible for the observed effects.

key_claims: Learn about the warnings for sleep, skin and bodybuilding products that contain hidden drugs and other hidden ingredients.
